messages:
Maya K: quick heads-up — found a broken screenshot link in docs/runtime/perf.md (image 403 from CDN). anyone owns that page?
Andrew L: thanks, can you paste the broken URL? i can send a quick PR.
Maya K: https://cdn.redwood-inference.com/docs/screens/perf-topology.png returns 403 for me. also noticed alt text is missing on that figure.
Sophie R: i own a chunk of runtime docs, i can take this. @Andrew L if you want to push the PR i can add myself to frontmatter. :+1:
Andrew L: i'll wait for the PR link. curious if it's a permissions thing or a path rewrite from the deploy last week.
Jordan P: quick check — if it's a cloudfront->s3 origin policy issue the object usually exists but origin policy rejects. can someone run `curl -I https://cdn.redwood-inference.com/docs/screens/perf-topology.png` and paste headers?
docs-bot: Automated check: remember to add an OWNERS entry in the doc frontmatter if you take responsibility for page ownership. See https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md#owners
Maya K: headers: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` `x-amz-cf-id: abc123` `x-cache: Error from cloudfront`. i can repro from both nyc and eu.
Sophie R: ok i'll do the following: 1) verify object in s3 2) add OWNERS: ["Sophie R"] to frontmatter 3) update image path if needed 4) add alt text and a caption fix. aim to open PR by end of day.
Andrew L: nice plan. if object is present in s3, check s3 object ACL + bucket policy. if path changed we can also update the path rewrite in our static-site build config.
Maya K: one more tiny note — caption currently has a typo: 'through puts' should be 'throughput'. i'll include that in the PR comment so it's not missed.
Sophie R: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345 — includes s3 verification steps in the PR body, alt text, caption fix, and adds frontmatter OWNERS. requesting review from @Andrew L. :rocket:
Andrew L: looking now. quick review: lgtm with one nit on caption punctuation. i'll run the curl test after you merge to confirm CDN picks up new origin headers.
Jordan P: after merge, also invalidate the cloudfront path `/docs/screens/perf-topology.png` or the directory so the 403 doesn't persist from cache.
Sophie R: noted — i'll include an invalidation step in the PR checklist. merging as soon as Andrew approves.
Andrew L: approved and merged.
Maya K: verified image loads for me from eu and nyc, alt text shows, caption fixed. thanks all! :tada:
